mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 98.0 index level indicates weakening manufacturing output, which signals economic contraction and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based collapse in housing demand, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 440000.0 and HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a monetary tightening regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.36 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% and decline in non-farm payrolls below 143,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 143000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based demand collapse, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 440000.0 and INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
